title: Can MLLMs Reason over Surround-View Driving Videos? A Multi-View Autonomous Driving QA Benchmark
abstract: arXiv:2611.15225v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Surround-view video understanding in autonomous driving is a crucial capability for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to achieve reliable driving reasoning. Real-world driving often requires information beyond the front-view camera. Existing MLLMs primarily focus on front-view information, while their spatio-temporal understanding and reasoning abilities remain unknown. To address this gap, we propose MVDriveBench, a high-information-density video QA benchmark for autonomous driving, characterized by synchronized surround-view inputs, spatio-temporal understanding, and reasoning-chain-oriented evaluation. We design 12 categories of QA tasks that cover the complete reasoning pipeline from low-level visual perception to high-level driving decision-making, enabling a systematic evaluation of MLLMs surround-view spatio-temporal understanding and reasoning capabilities in complex driving environments. translated_title: 多模态大语言模型能否对环视驾驶视频进行推理？一个多视角自动驾驶问答基准
translated_abstract: 自动驾驶中的环视视频理解是多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）实现可靠驾驶推理的一项关键能力。现实世界的驾驶场景往往需要前置摄像头之外的信息。现有MLLMs主要关注前置视角信息，而其时空理解与推理能力仍是未知。为填补这一空白，我们提出了MVDriveBench，一个面向自动驾驶的高信息密度视频问答基准，其特点是同步的环视输入、时空理解以及面向推理链的评估。我们设计了12类问答任务，涵盖从低层视觉感知到高层驾驶决策的完整推理流程，从而能够系统地评估MLLMs在复杂驾驶环境中的环视时空理解与推理能力。我们对……进行了全面的评估。
tldr: 提出了MVDriveBench——一个面向自动驾驶的高信息密度环视视频问答基准，通过12类覆盖从视觉感知到驾驶决策完整推理链的任务，系统评估多模态大语言模型的环视时空理解与推理能力。
en_tdlr: MVDriveBench is proposed as a high-information-density surround-view video QA benchmark for autonomous driving, with 12 QA task categories spanning the full reasoning chain from visual perception to driving decisions to systematically evaluate MLLMs' spatio-temporal understanding and reasoning.
